title: Three sisters of 1RB0RF_1LC1RE_0LD0LC_1RD0RB_1RA0RB_0LC---: halting needs a lost race, in Lean
text: For 1RB0RF_1LC1RE_0LD0LC_1RD0RB_1RA0RB_0RB---, 1RB0RF_1LC1RE_0LD0LC_1RD0RB_1RA0RB_1RC--- and 1RB1RF_1LC1RE_0LD0LC_1RD0RB_1RA0RB_1RE--- the collisions and the one-unit anomaly, which were simulated cell by cell, are now general Lean rules (69, 69 and 37 cases from a symbolic case split), giving a closed-form macro map. The race invariant of the 0LC--- machine carries over: each machine never halts unless a race is lost.
